_instructions.how_to_add_an_article: Copy one of the article objects below, paste it at the TOP of the articles array (newest first), and fill in your details. The site will automatically show the 6 most recent.
_instructions.images: LinkedIn CDN URLs expire and block external requests — they will never load on an external site. Instead: save your article cover image to your computer, upload it to the assets/ folder in your GitHub repo, then reference it as 'assets/your-image-name.jpg'. If image is left empty, a styled VL placeholder shows instead.
_instructions.url: Paste the full LinkedIn article URL
